name: Fruit Beer Game
author: Prof. Viral Bhatt, IIM Ahmedabad
description: Experience the bullwhip effect in a 4-tier supply chain. Make ordering decisions as Retailer, Wholesaler, Distributor, or Manufacturer and witness how small demand changes amplify across the chain.
learning_objectives: Understand bullwhip effect and demand amplification
Learn inventory management and ordering strategies
Analyze cost implications of poor forecasting

name: Theory of Constraints Factory
author: Parasmani Skills Team
description: Manage a factory with 5 machines producing Products A & B. Identify bottlenecks, optimize throughput using DBR (Drum-Buffer-Rope), and maximize profit while managing WIP.
learning_objectives: Balance throughput, inventory, and operating expense

name: Order Ops - Food Delivery
author: Parasmani Skills Team
description: Real-time food delivery logistics simulation. Assign drivers to orders, optimize routes, manage delivery partners, and minimize costs while maximizing customer satisfaction.

name: To Pay or Not to Pay - HR Compensation
author: Prof. Vasanthi Srinivasan, IIM Bangalore
description: Navigate the complexity of salary decisions. Select experts, weight attributes, evaluate candidates, and negotiate compensation packages while balancing market benchmarks and stakeholder expectations.

name: Sustainable Select - MADM
author: Parasmani Skills Team
description: Multi-Attribute Decision Making (MADM) simulation. Apply WSM, WPM, TOPSIS, and MOORA methods to rank alternatives. Learn entropy and CRITIC weighting techniques.
learning_objectives: Apply MADM methods (WSM, WPM, TOPSIS, MOORA)

name: Onion Dilemma - Game Theory
author: Prof. Viral Bhatt, IIM Ahmedabad
description: A game-theory based supply chain simulation. Play as Farmer-Coordinator or Retailer-Coordinator. Make simultaneous decisions, build trust, and navigate cooperation vs defection dilemmas.

name: Dual Source Dilemma
author: Parasmani Skills Team
description: Procurement simulation with two suppliers offering different cost-leadtime tradeoffs. Manage cash flow, handle demand uncertainty, and optimize supplier mix to maximize bank balance.

name: Defect Detectives - Quality Control
author: Parasmani Skills Team
description: Quality control simulation using 7 QC tools: check sheets, histograms, Pareto charts, fishbone diagrams, scatter plots, flowcharts, and control charts. Identify root causes and reduce defects.

name: Customer In A Store - Cognitive Bias
author: Prof. Raghunathan, IIM Ahmedabad
description: Stock-flow reasoning simulation. Interpret inflow/outflow graphs, calculate stock levels, and overcome correlation heuristic bias. Track your learning improvement across variations.

name: EV Gambit - Strategic Management
author: Parasmani Skills Team
description: Strategic management simulation based on Porter's Five Forces. Navigate industry events, make strategic decisions, respond to competitive moves, and gain market share in the EV industry.

name: Demand Forecast Challenge
author: Parasmani Skills Team
description: Time-series forecasting simulation. Apply various forecasting methods (moving average, exponential smoothing, regression) and compete to achieve the lowest forecast error.
